description: Heavy synchronous work on the main thread of a client app. lib/sudoku.ts retries puzzle generation in a `while (true)` loop with a brute-force uniqueness check, called from a click handler in SudokuBoard. lib/outbox.ts busy-waits in `while (true)` for edits to finish uploading: the awaits are inside the forEach's async callbacks, which suspend each callback but never the loop, so the fetches can never complete and the tab freezes. ContactImport runs an O(n^2) pairwise edit-distance comparison over every CSV row inside the parse callback; the rule only recognises `while (true)`, so deeply nested iteration is a known gap.
